schema.title: JSON schema for Visual Studio manifest extensions

description:
The application registers two file types. Files ending with **.myext** are identified by the prog‑ID **MyApp.File**, carry the MIME type **application/x‑myapp**, and are recorded under the registry key **Software\Classes\MyApp.File**. These files are treated as regular documents (perceived type “document”) and are not icon‑only, so they will display their full name in Explorer. Files ending with **.data** are linked to the prog‑ID **MyApp.Data**, use the generic MIME type **application/octet‑stream**, and are marked as icon‑only, meaning they are shown only by their icon and have no explicit registry path defined in this manifest.  

In addition, the suite defines two protocol handlers. The custom protocol **myapp** is bound to **MyApp.Protocol**, registered at **Software\Classes\myapp**, and appears in user interfaces as “MyApp Protocol Handler” (localization ID 1001). The secondary protocol **mydata** maps to **MyApp.DataProtocol** and is registered under **Software\Classes\mydata** without a display name.  

The manifest also declares two prog‑ID entries. **MyApp.File** is presented to users as “My Application File”, launches **C:\Program Files\MyApp\MyApp.exe** with the argument `--open "%1"`, and uses the icon located at **C:\Program Files\MyApp\MyApp.ico** (icon index 0). Its settings enforce always‑show‑extension, disallow silent default takeover, associate the AppUserModelId **MyApp.1**, and include the CLSID **{12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890AB}** together with an icon handler **{87654321-4321-4321-4321-BA0987654321}**. The second entry, **MyApp.Protocol**, is shown as “My Application Protocol”, also starts the same executable with `--protocol "%1"`, and requires DDE support, specifying the DDE application name **MyApp** and the DDE topic **System**.
